name: Cauliflower 'Potato' Salad
steps: Steam cauliflower florets 6–8 minutes until just tender; cool completely.
Mix yogurt, mayo, Dijon and salt.
Fold in cauliflower, chopped eggs, celery, onion and pickle; top with paprika and chives. Chill 1 hour.

name: Grilled Chicken Fattoush
steps: Grill seasoned chicken; slice. Toast pita until crisp and break into shards.
Whisk oil, lemon, sumac and garlic.
Toss lettuce, cucumber, tomato, radish, herbs with dressing; add chicken and pita.

name: Shrimp & Avocado Mango Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp with cumin 3 minutes; cool.
Toss mango, avocado, onion, jalapeño, cilantro with lime and oil.
Serve with shrimp over greens.

name: Lemony Lentil & Arugula Salad with Salmon
steps: Roast salmon at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Whisk lemon, olive oil and Dijon; toss with lentils, tomatoes, onion and parsley.
Serve on arugula with flaked salmon.

name: Chicken Larb Lettuce Salad
steps: Brown chicken in avocado oil, breaking it up, 8 minutes.
Off heat toss with shallot, lime juice, fish sauce, herbs, green onion and pepper flakes.
Serve in lettuce cups with cucumber.

name: Hearts of Palm 'Crab' Salad
steps: Shred hearts of palm with a fork.
Mix with celery, onion, yogurt, mayo, Dijon, Old Bay and lemon.
Serve in lettuce cups.

name: Tuna Avocado Salad Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Mash avocado with lemon and Dijon; fold in tuna, celery and onion.
Hollow out tomatoes.
Fill with tuna salad and top with chives.

name: Pomegranate Kale Salad with Chicken
steps: Grill chicken; slice.
Massage kale with oil, lemon, Dijon and honey.
Top with chicken, pomegranate, walnuts and feta.

name: Zucchini Ribbon Salad with Parmesan & Pine Nuts
steps: Shave zucchini into ribbons with a peeler.
Toss with lemon, olive oil, beans and basil.
Top with parmesan shavings, pine nuts and pepper.

name: Beef Taco Salad Bowl
steps: Brown beef with taco seasoning, drain.
Layer romaine, beans, tomato and beef.
Top with cheddar, avocado, salsa, yogurt and green onion.

name: Cucumber Tomato Feta Salad
steps: Chop cucumber and tomato; slice onion thin.
Toss with olives, oil, vinegar and oregano.
Top with feta.

name: Chicken & Farro Harvest Salad
steps: Grill chicken and dice.
Whisk oil, vinegar and Dijon; massage into chopped kale.
Toss with farro, apple, pecans, goat cheese and chicken.

name: Spicy Chickpea & Avocado Smash Salad
steps: Mash chickpeas and avocado together roughly.
Stir in lemon, hot sauce, cumin, celery, onion and cilantro.
Serve over romaine.

name: Seared Scallop Salad with Citrus Vinaigrette
steps: Pat scallops dry, sear in avocado oil 90 seconds per side.
Whisk olive oil, orange juice and Dijon.
Toss greens with dressing; top with grapefruit segments, avocado, scallops and chives.

name: Egg Salad Stuffed Avocados
steps: Hard-boil and chop eggs.
Mix with yogurt, Dijon, celery, chives and salt.
Halve avocados and fill; dust with paprika.

name: Turkey BLT Salad
steps: Crisp turkey bacon; chop.
Mix yogurt, mayo, lemon and chives.
Toss romaine, tomato, turkey, bacon and avocado with dressing.

name: Arugula, Fennel & Salmon Salad
steps: Roast salmon at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Shave fennel and segment orange.
Toss arugula, fennel, orange and olives with oil and lemon; top with salmon.

name: Buffalo Cauliflower & Chicken Salad
steps: Toss cauliflower in oil and half the hot sauce; roast at 425°F 22 minutes.
Mix yogurt, blue cheese, lemon and remaining hot sauce.
Toss romaine, celery, carrot, chicken and cauliflower with dressing.

name: Thai Beef Salad
steps: Grill steak 4 minutes per side; rest and slice thin.
Whisk lime, fish sauce and pepper flakes.
Toss greens, cucumber, tomato, onion, herbs and steak with dressing; top with peanuts.

name: Caprese Chicken Salad
steps: Grill chicken; slice.
Arrange greens, tomato, mozzarella and chicken.
Drizzle oil and balsamic; scatter basil.

name: Sesame Chicken Soba Salad
steps: Poach or grill chicken; shred.
Whisk tamari, vinegar, sesame oil and ginger.
Toss cold soba with chicken, vegetables and dressing; sprinkle sesame.

name: Cajun Shrimp & Avocado Corn Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp in oil with Cajun seasoning 3 minutes.
Char corn 3 minutes in the same pan.
Toss with avocado, tomato, onion, cilantro, lime; serve over romaine.

name: Greek Lentil Salad
steps: Combine lentils, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives and parsley.
Dress with oil, vinegar and oregano.
Fold in feta.

name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Chopped Salad
steps: Grill chicken and crisp bacon; chop.
Whisk yogurt, ranch seasoning and lemon.
Toss everything with the dressing.

name: Roasted Broccoli & Chickpea Salad
steps: Roast broccoli and chickpeas with oil, garlic and pepper flakes at 425°F 20 minutes.
Toss with lemon juice.
Top with parmesan and almonds; serve warm.

name: Shrimp Cobb Salad
steps: Sauté shrimp 3 minutes; crisp bacon; boil eggs.
Whisk oil, vinegar and Dijon.
Arrange all over romaine; drizzle dressing.

name: Cabbage & Apple Slaw with Pork Tenderloin
steps: Season pork and roast at 425°F 18–20 minutes; rest and slice.
Whisk yogurt, Dijon and vinegar.
Toss shredded cabbage, apple and carrot with dressing; serve with pork.

name: Miso-Ginger Salmon Salad
steps: Whisk miso, ginger, vinegar and sesame oil; brush half on salmon and roast at 400°F 12 minutes.
Toss greens, cucumber, edamame and radish with remaining dressing.
Top with salmon and sesame seeds.

name: Southwest Quinoa Salad with Grilled Chicken
steps: Grill chicken; dice.
Whisk lime, oil and cumin.
Toss quinoa, beans, pepper, corn, cilantro with dressing; top with chicken and avocado.

name: Tomato, Cucumber & Hemp Seed Salad
steps: Chop tomato and cucumber; slice onion.
Toss with oil, vinegar, dill and salt.
Sprinkle hemp seeds.

name: Chicken Souvlaki Salad
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon, oregano, garlic and half the oil; grill 6 minutes per side and slice.
Mix yogurt, dill and grated cucumber (a little) for tzatziki.
Toss salad vegetables with remaining oil; top with chicken, feta and tzatziki.

name: Winter Citrus & Avocado Salad with Shrimp
steps: Sauté shrimp 3 minutes; cool.
Segment citrus.
Toss greens with oil and lime; top with citrus, avocado, onion, shrimp, pistachios and mint.

name: Loaded Kale Salad with Chicken & Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Roast chickpeas with half the oil and paprika at 425°F 22 minutes.
Grill chicken; slice.
Massage kale with remaining oil, lemon and garlic; toss with tomatoes, chicken, chickpeas and parmesan.

name: Cold Sesame Zoodle Salad with Shrimp
steps: Sauté shrimp 3 minutes; cool.
Whisk tahini, tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and a little water.
Toss zoodles and cucumber with sauce; top with shrimp, green onion and sesame.

name: Cottage Cheese Veggie Salad Bowl
steps: Chop vegetables.
Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl and surround with vegetables.
Drizzle oil, add seeds, dill and pepper.

name: Smoked Turkey & Apple Kale Salad
steps: Whisk oil, vinegar and Dijon; massage into kale.
Add sliced apple, turkey and cheddar.
Top with walnuts.

name: Mediterranean Tuna Stuffed Peppers Salad
steps: Mix tuna, chickpeas, cucumber, olives, feta, parsley with oil and lemon.
Halve and seed peppers.
Fill with the tuna mixture.

name: Pesto Chicken Pasta Salad (Chickpea Pasta)
steps: Cook pasta al dente; rinse cool.
Grill chicken; dice.
Toss pasta, chicken, tomatoes, mozzarella and arugula with pesto and lemon.

name: Ginger Carrot & Edamame Salad
steps: Shred carrot; slice cucumber.
Whisk ginger, vinegar, tamari and sesame oil.
Toss with edamame and green onion; top with sesame.

name: Chicken Gyro Bowl Salad
steps: Season chicken with oregano, garlic, lemon and oil; sear and slice.
Make tzatziki with yogurt, dill and grated cucumber.
Bowl romaine, tomato, cucumber, onion, chicken and tzatziki; serve with toasted pita half.

name: Marinated Mushroom & White Bean Salad
steps: Sauté mushrooms with garlic and thyme in oil 6 minutes.
Toss warm mushrooms with beans, balsamic and parsley.
Serve over arugula with parmesan.

name: Chili Lime Steak & Avocado Salad
steps: Rub steak with chili powder; sear 4 minutes per side; rest, slice.
Toss romaine, tomato, onion with lime and oil.
Top with steak, avocado, cotija, cilantro.

name: Salmon Caesar Salad
steps: Roast salmon at 400°F 12 minutes.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, Dijon, anchovy, garlic and oil.
Toss romaine with dressing; top with salmon, parmesan and capers.

name: Radish, Cucumber & Dill Salad with Smoked Trout
steps: Slice radish and cucumber thin.
Mix yogurt, dill, lemon and oil.
Toss vegetables in dressing; top with flaked trout and rye croutons.

name: Spinach & Chickpea Salad with Tahini Dressing
steps: Whisk tahini, lemon, garlic and water.
Toss spinach, chickpeas, cucumber, tomato and onion.
Drizzle with dressing; sprinkle sumac.

name: Peach, Mozzarella & Prosciutto Salad
steps: Slice peach and mozzarella.
Arrange with prosciutto over arugula.
Drizzle oil and balsamic; add basil and pepper.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Tabbouleh
steps: Grill chicken; dice.
Pulse raw cauliflower rice with parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber and green onion.
Dress with lemon, oil and salt; fold in chicken.

name: Autumn Roasted Squash & Arugula Salad
steps: Roast diced squash with half the oil, cinnamon and salt at 425°F 22 minutes.
Toss arugula and chickpeas with remaining oil and balsamic.
Top with squash, seeds and goat cheese.

name: Shrimp & Hearts of Palm Ceviche Salad
steps: Poach shrimp 3 minutes, chop and chill.
Toss with hearts of palm, tomato, onion, cilantro, jalapeño, lime and salt; marinate 20 minutes.
Fold in avocado and oil.

name: Chicken Vegetable Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and celery in olive oil 6 minutes; add garlic.
Add broth, chicken, thyme, bay leaf and salt; simmer 20 minutes; remove chicken and shred.
Add green beans and zucchini, simmer 6 minutes; return chicken and finish with parsley.

name: Turkey Chili
steps: Brown turkey in olive oil with onion and pepper, 8 minutes; add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes, beans, broth and salt; simmer uncovered 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve with Greek yogurt and cilantro if desired.

name: Red Lentil Soup with Lemon
steps: Sauté onion and carrot in oil 6 minutes; add garlic, cumin and turmeric.
Add dry lentils and broth; simmer 25 minutes until soft.
Blend partially, stir in lemon juice and salt; garnish with cilantro.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup (Lightened)
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add broccoli, cauliflower and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend two-thirds of the soup until smooth (cauliflower replaces flour as thickener).
Stir in milk, cheddar, Dijon and salt; heat gently without boiling.

name: Beef & Barley Soup
steps: Brown cubed beef in oil; remove. Sauté onion, carrot, celery and mushrooms 8 minutes.
Add tomato paste, garlic, broth, beef, thyme and bay leaf; simmer 60 minutes.
Add dry barley and simmer 30 minutes more until tender; season.

name: Tuscan White Bean & Kale Soup
steps: Brown sliced sausage in oil; add onion, carrot and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, beans and rosemary; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in kale until wilted; serve with parmesan.

name: Thai Coconut Chicken Soup (Tom Kha)
steps: Simmer broth with ginger, lemongrass and curry paste 10 minutes.
Add sliced chicken and mushrooms; cook 8 minutes.
Add coconut milk, fish sauce and lime; heat through. Top with cilantro, green onion and chili.

name: Black Bean Soup
steps: Sauté onion, pepper and garlic in oil with cumin and chili powder 6 minutes.
Add beans and broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend half the soup, stir back in with lime and salt; top with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup (No Chips)
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, jalapeño and garlic with spices in oil 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred the chicken.
Add beans and heat; serve with avocado, cheddar, cilantro and lime.

name: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend smooth with milk, nutmeg and salt; garnish with parmesan and chives.

name: Lentil Vegetable Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and celery in oil 7 minutes; add garlic and spices.
Add dry lentils, tomatoes and broth; simmer 30 minutes.
Stir in spinach and vinegar; season.

name: Italian Wedding Soup with Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix turkey, egg, half the parmesan, almond flour and seasoning; roll into small meatballs.
Sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic in oil; add broth and simmer.
Drop in meatballs, cook 12 minutes; add spinach and remaining parmesan.

name: Split Pea Soup with Ham
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and celery in oil 6 minutes; add garlic.
Add dry split peas, ham, broth, bay leaf and thyme; simmer 60–70 minutes until peas break down.
Remove bay leaf; season with pepper.

name: Egg Drop Soup with Tofu & Spinach
steps: Simmer broth with ginger and tamari; add tofu cubes.
Drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring slowly to make ribbons.
Add spinach, sesame oil and green onion.

name: Salmon Chowder (Cauliflower Base)
steps: Sauté onion, celery, carrot and garlic in oil 6 minutes.
Add cauliflower and broth; simmer 12 minutes. Blend half for creaminess.
Add salmon chunks and milk; simmer 6 minutes; finish with dill and lemon.

name: Minestrone with Chickpea Pasta
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery in oil 7 minutes; add garlic and seasoning.
Add tomatoes, broth, beans; simmer 15 minutes; add zucchini and green beans for 6 minutes.
Cook pasta separately and add to bowls; top with parmesan.

name: Chicken Zoodle Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery in oil; add garlic and thyme.
Add broth and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Add zoodles for 2 minutes; finish with parsley and lemon.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
steps: Sauté onion and carrot in oil 6 minutes; add garlic and spices 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, broth, chickpeas and harissa; simmer 20 minutes.
Add zucchini for 8 minutes; finish with lemon and cilantro.

name: Hearty Beef Stew with Root Vegetables
steps: Brown beef cubes in oil in batches; remove.
Sauté onion, celery, mushrooms; add tomato paste, garlic, wine and reduce 2 minutes.
Return beef with broth, thyme, bay leaf; simmer covered 90 minutes. Add carrot and turnip; cook 30 minutes more.

name: Gazpacho
steps: Roughly chop vegetables.
Blend with garlic, oil, vinegar, salt and cumin until smooth.
Chill 2 hours; serve cold.

name: Chicken & White Bean Chili
steps: Sauté onion and garlic with spices in oil 5 minutes.
Add broth, chicken, beans and chiles; simmer 25 minutes; shred chicken.
Mash a few beans to thicken; stir in yogurt, lime, cilantro and salt.

name: Miso Soup with Tofu & Wakame
steps: Simmer broth with sliced shiitake 5 minutes; add tofu and wakame.
Remove from heat; whisk miso with a little broth and stir in.
Top with green onion.

name: Roasted Tomato Basil Soup
steps: Roast halved tomatoes, onion and garlic with oil at 400°F for 35 minutes.
Blend with broth, white beans (for body and protein) and basil.
Simmer 5 minutes; season.

name: Shrimp & Sausage Gumbo (Light Roux-Free)
steps: Brown sausage in oil; add onion, pepper, celery and cook 8 minutes; add garlic.
Add tomatoes, broth, okra, Cajun seasoning and bay leaf; simmer 25 minutes.
Add shrimp for 4 minutes; serve over sautéed cauliflower rice with green onion.

name: Mushroom & Wild Rice Soup
steps: Sauté mushrooms in oil until browned; add onion, carrot, celery and garlic 5 minutes.
Add broth, thyme; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cooked wild rice and milk; heat; serve with parmesan.

name: Chicken Pho (Zoodle)
steps: Simmer broth with ginger, star anise, cinnamon and fish sauce 15 minutes; poach chicken in it 10 minutes; slice.
Strain broth over zoodles in bowls.
Top with chicken, sprouts, herbs, lime, jalapeño and green onion.

name: Curried Butternut & Lentil Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and curry powder in oil 5 minutes.
Add squash, dry lentils and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Blend, stir in coconut milk, lime and salt; garnish with cilantro.

name: Turkey Meatball & Vegetable Soup
steps: Mix turkey, egg, almond flour, garlic powder; form meatballs.
Sauté onion and carrot; add broth, tomatoes, seasoning; simmer.
Add meatballs 12 minutes; add zucchini and green beans 6 minutes; serve with parmesan.

name: Caldo de Pollo (Mexican Chicken Soup)
steps: Simmer chicken in broth with onion, garlic, cumin and salt 25 minutes; shred.
Add carrot, cabbage and zucchini; cook 10 minutes.
Serve with cilantro, lime, jalapeño and avocado.

name: Creamy Zucchini Basil Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add zucchini and cook 5 minutes.
Add broth and beans; simmer 12 minutes.
Blend with basil and lemon; season; top with parmesan.

name: Kimchi Tofu Stew (Sundubu-Style)
steps: Sauté kimchi and garlic in sesame oil 3 minutes.
Add broth, gochujang, mushrooms and zucchini; simmer 8 minutes.
Add tofu chunks; crack in eggs and cook 3 minutes; top with green onion.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup with Cauliflower Rice
steps: Simmer chicken with onion and carrot in broth 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Add cauliflower rice, cook 5 minutes.
Whisk eggs with lemon; temper with hot broth and stir in off heat (avgolemono); add dill and salt.

name: Vegetarian Three-Bean Chili
steps: Sauté onion, pepper and zucchini in oil 8 minutes; add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes, beans, broth and cocoa; simmer 30 minutes.
Season and serve with yogurt or avocado.

name: Clam Chowder (Cauliflower-Thickened)
steps: Crisp turkey bacon; set aside. Sauté onion and celery in oil.
Add cauliflower, potato, broth, thyme; simmer 15 minutes; blend half.
Add clams and milk; heat 5 minutes; top with bacon and pepper.

name: Spicy Peanut Sweet Potato Stew
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and spices in oil 5 minutes.
Add sweet potato, tomatoes, broth and chickpeas; simmer 20 minutes.
Whisk in peanut butter, add spinach and lime; season.

name: Chicken Cabbage Soup
steps: Sauté onion and carrot in oil; add garlic and paprika.
Add broth, tomatoes and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Add cabbage and cook 8 minutes; finish with dill.

name: Cioppino (Seafood Stew)
steps: Sauté onion, fennel and garlic in oil 6 minutes; add pepper flakes and oregano.
Add wine, tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Add mussels, cod and shrimp; cover and cook 6 minutes until mussels open; finish with parsley.

name: Greens & Beans Soup with Turkey Sausage
steps: Brown sausage; add onion and garlic 4 minutes.
Add broth and beans; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in chard until wilted; finish with lemon and parmesan.

name: Carrot Ginger Soup
steps: Sauté onion, ginger and garlic in oil 5 minutes.
Add carrot, beans and broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend with coconut milk and lime; season.

name: Pork & Napa Cabbage Soup
steps: Brown pork with ginger and garlic; add tamari.
Add broth and shiitake; simmer 8 minutes.
Add cabbage and tofu; cook 5 minutes; finish with sesame oil and green onion.

name: Chickpea Noodle Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery in oil; add garlic, thyme, turmeric.
Add broth and chickpeas; simmer 12 minutes.
Add pasta and cook 6–7 minutes; finish with parsley and lemon.

name: Beef & Cabbage Soup
steps: Brown beef with onion in oil; add garlic and paprika.
Add broth, tomatoes, carrot and cabbage; simmer 25 minutes.
Finish with vinegar and salt.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala Soup
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and spices in oil 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, chicken and cauliflower; simmer 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Stir in yogurt off heat; garnish cilantro.

name: Asparagus & Leek Soup
steps: Sauté leek and garlic in oil 6 minutes.
Add asparagus, beans and broth; simmer 12 minutes.
Blend smooth with lemon; serve with yogurt and chives.

name: Hot & Sour Soup
steps: Simmer broth with shiitake, ginger, tamari and vinegar 8 minutes.
Add tofu strips; drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring.
Finish with sesame oil, pepper, sprouts and green onion.

name: Lamb & Chickpea Stew
steps: Brown lamb cubes in oil; remove. Sauté onion, carrot, garlic and spices 6 minutes.
Return lamb with tomatoes and broth; simmer covered 60 minutes.
Add chickpeas for 20 minutes; finish with lemon and cilantro.

name: Creamy Mushroom Soup (No Cream)
steps: Sear mushrooms in oil until browned; add onion, garlic, thyme; deglaze with wine.
Add cauliflower and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with milk; season.

name: Shrimp Coconut Curry Soup
steps: Fry curry paste and ginger 1 minute; add broth and coconut milk; simmer 5 minutes.
Add pepper, mushrooms and snap peas; cook 4 minutes.
Add shrimp 3 minutes; finish with fish sauce, lime and basil.

name: Southwest Turkey & Bean Soup
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper in oil; add garlic and spices.
Add beans, tomatoes, chiles, broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Finish with cilantro and lime.
